newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +3.90 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +3.90 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 26.576 to the dollar after Thursday's fixing at 26.527, and at 17.551 to the mark from 17.568.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +3.90 percent, the same as on Thursday.
During the minute the central bank calculated the fixing, the crown traded on the interbank market at +3.89 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
